summary: Returns TRUE when the double-precision difference between the two float arguments a1 and a2 lies inside the symmetric tolerance band [-0.00000011920929, +0.00000011920929]. This is a float-equality / near-zero tolerance check; eleven vector and quaternion normalization and rotation callers (QuatNormalize 0x0050DECF, QuaternionConjugateAndNormalize 0x0050DF9B, RotationVectorToQuaternion 0x0050E055, AxisAngleToQuaternion 0x0050E0D9, sub_50E342, Vector4NormalizeWithLengthThreshold 0x0050E3E0, F_2DVectorNormalizeWithFallback 0x0050E6D3, sub_50E7CB, VectorNormalization 0x0050E887, F_44MatrixTransform 0x0050E927, QuaternionNormalize 0x0050ED19) use it as the magnitude near-zero gate before normalizing.

operations.description: Compute v2 = a1 - a2 in double precision.

Compare v2 against the symmetric epsilon band: pass when v2 >= -0.00000011920929 and v2 <= 0.00000011920929. The two epsilon literals are backed by the packet read-globals flt_5AC9C0 (0x005AC9C0) and flt_5ADE3C (0x005ADE3C); which global backs which literal is DERIVED.
Return the boolean result of the tolerance comparison (nonzero when inside the band).
Used by the normalization and rotation callers (e.g. QuatNormalize 0x0050DECF, QuaternionNormalize 0x0050ED19) as the near-zero tolerance gate before normalizing.
